title: People directory — HR employee table
notes: v2 is a Tailwind UI rewrite: BEM classes replaced by utilities, the left filter sidebar becomes a filter bar, the app header moves into a <kestrel-app-bar> declarative shadow root (with a global search decoy), rows are re-sorted by start date (newest first), columns are reordered and a Manager column is inserted, an aria-hidden sticky clone of the header row precedes the real table, a hidden mobile filter drawer duplicates the search box, the Edit button becomes a link with sr-only row name, row menus lose aria-label/testids, ids regenerate.
